summary_rationale: MPS Limited is a 56-year-old content-engineering and platform franchise embedded in the production workflows of the world's largest scholarly and education publishers. The audited record is that of a cash compounder: ten-year operating cash flow roughly equals ten-year profit after tax (about 1.0x), capital expenditure is about 1% of revenue, ROCE has sat in the mid-30s to high-30s percent range since FY23, EBITDA has compounded at roughly 17% a year since FY21, the balance sheet is debt-free again after the Unbound Medicine term loan was repaid in August 2026, and about ₹651 Cr (nearly all of FY19-FY25 profit) was returned to shareholders. Research Solutions, 60% of revenue, now runs at a 45-48% EBITDA margin on near-flat headcount, and Unbound adds subscription revenue with institutional renewals. The pass carries real conditions: one customer is 17.3% of revenue and the top 15 are 58%; goodwill plus acquired intangibles are 52.5% of total assets and the Unbound purchase-price allocation is provisional until February 2027; Corporate Learning shrank 16.5% in FY26 and has missed three recovery dates; reported growth is lumpy (+33% in FY25, 92% of it from the AJE acquisition, then +6% in FY26); generative AI is deflating the unit price of content production and the evidence that MPS keeps the savings is one segment's margin trend; and the promoter holding company is merging into MPS. KPI health is therefore PASS_WITH_WATCH: the cash, margin and return KPIs pass, while customer concentration, acquired-asset quality, Corporate Learning recovery and AI price-give-back are the four items that must keep passing.
